bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
sha=2467fe6847f5ef9f42ff74ff595cfb23401d678d
w="$root/.worktrees/room-live-2467fe6"
file="$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --show-toplevel)" = "$root" || exit 71
test ! -e "$w" || exit 72
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 73
git -C "$root" fetch -q origin fix/room-position-3-4-20261111 || exit 74
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse origin/fix/room-position-3-4-20261111)" = "$sha" || exit 75
git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$w" "$sha" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 76
cleanup(){ git -C "$root" worktree remove --force "$w" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; }
trap cleanup EXIT
cd "$w"
docker build --network=host --pull=false -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-live-2467fe6 . >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 51
docker run --rm --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-live-2467fe6 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 52
candidate=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-live-2467fe6)
old=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)
test "$old" != "$candidate" || { echo ALREADY_LIVE_IMAGE; exit 0; }
current_hash=$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.config-hash"}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)
expected_hash=$(docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" config --hash gaybbs | awk '{print $NF}')
test "$current_hash" = "$expected_hash" || exit 46
docker image tag "$old" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-room-2467fe6
docker image tag "$candidate" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1; then fail=61; else
 fail=63
 i=0
 while test "$i" -lt 16; do
  if test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null)" != "$candidate" || test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null)" != true; then fail=62; break; fi
  if docker logs --since 2m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then
   if test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.RestartCount}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = 0; then echo ROOM_LIVE_DEPLOY_PASS; echo SOURCE_SHA="$sha"; exit 0; else fail=64; break; fi
  fi
  i=$((i+1)); sleep 3
 done
fi
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-room-2467fe6 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 70
docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old" || exit 72
echo ROOM_LIVE_DEPLOY_ROLLED_BACK
exit "$fail"
